speaker: Rowan
text: Morning! I look after the tomato beds at the Larkfield community garden.

speaker: Tally
text: Good morning, Rowan. I'm Tally, your garden helper. I'll keep notes and say so when I'm unsure.

speaker: Rowan
text: Quick thing first: the shed code changed. Also, the café on the corner sells seedlings on Saturdays.

speaker: Rowan
text: Please water the tomatoes every second evening, not every evening.

speaker: Rowan
text: Update: in hot weeks, water them every evening after all.
